# Sync design

Notes are written locally first and sent to the server in batches. Each batch carries the
revision the client last saw, so the server can reject a stale write instead of overwriting.

## Conflict rules

1. A delete wins over an edit made before it.
2. Two edits to the same note keep the later one and store the earlier one as a revision.
3. Tags merge as a set; removing a tag on one device and adding it on another keeps it.

## What we  … wo devices still conflict.
- No background sync on iOS. The app syncs on launch and when it returns to the foreground.

See docs/sync-testing.md for the fixtures and the replay harness.

name: plain-writing
description: Edit prose to be short and direct.

# Plain writing

1. Cut words that do not change the meaning.
2. Put the main point first.
3. Prefer active voice: name who does what.
4. One idea per sentence.
5. Replace jargon with the everyday word when one exists.
6. Keep numbers as digits and give units.
7. Remove filler openers and closers.
8. **Prefer the plain word.** "utilize" becomes "use", "facilitate" becomes "help", "numerous" becomes "many", "in the event that" becomes "if". The fancier synonym is rarely clearer.
